## DockDoor relaunch hardening
- Repairs the per-user theme persistence monitor when the DockDoor helper is launched directly. - Persists the actual loopback port selected after a cold Codex restart, including non-default ports. - Makes the persistence agent report load failures instead of silently appearing successful. - Labels the DockDoor helper `Codex Studio (Themed)` so it is distinguishable from the stock Codex shortcut. - Keeps the bundled runtime version aligned with the release that installed it.

# Codex Studio 0.1.3
## Reliable themed relaunches
- Applying a theme now enables the managed per-user relaunch monitor, so launching the stock Codex app after `⌘Q` automatically restores the verified theme. - The DockDoor-compatible launcher follows the actual CDP port selected by the runtime after a restart instead of assuming port 9341. - Restoring the original Codex appearance disables the relaunch monitor.

# Codex Studio 0.1.2
## DockDoor update recovery
- Bundles the DockDoor-compatible `Codex Themed.app` launcher and the Codex Studio icon. - Installs or upgrades the launcher without replacing an unrelated app with the same display name. - Starts the official signed Codex app through the managed theme engine, keeps the helper alive for DockDoor, and repairs a stock Codex launch after an app update. - Refreshes an existing theme persistence monitor after a runtime migration so it uses the updated repair logic.
## Sparkle migration
- Upgrades an older managed theme runtime atomically when the bundled runtime version is newer, while preserving a newer local runtime. - Carries the launcher and runtime migration to existing installations through the Sparkle update path. - Continues to ship the complete bundled theme library and apply-and-verify flow.

# Codex Studio 0.1.1
## Bundled theme library
- Ships all 130 theme packages from the managed Codex library inside the app bundle. - Seeds missing bundled packages into `~/Library/Application Support/CodexDreamSkinStudio/themes` on first launch while preserving existing local themes. - Future packages added under `Resources/ThemePacks` are included automatically in the next release build.
## Apply reliability
- Ships the Codex Dream Skin apply runtime inside the app bundle. - Installs the bundled runtime only when a managed runtime is not already present. - Keeps the existing apply-and-verify flow and avoids reporting success until Codex confirms the requested theme.
## Packaging
- Updated the app bundle assembly to include the complete theme library and runtime. - Retained provenance and licensing guidance for bundled theme packages and the upstream runtime in `ATTRIBUTIONS.md`.

# Codex Studio 0.1.0
Codex Studio is a new native macOS theme studio for shaping and applying an art-directed Codex workspace.
## Highlights
- Adds the responsive Codex Studio shell with Canvas, Themes, Library, Settings, and Live Editor workspaces. - Adds a curated visual library plus discovery of the local managed Codex theme collection. - Adds a live emulated Codex canvas with surface selection, palette controls, opacity, softness, and corner-radius tuning. - Keeps theme application explicit and verifies the requested runtime state after the switch completes. - Adds the original Codex Studio glass-aperture app icon. - Adds Sparkle 2.9.6 with signed GitHub release-feed support.
## Compatibility
- Apple Silicon. - macOS 14 or later. - Existing local Codex theme runtime installation required for applying managed themes.
